notes: Security pass 2026-08-04: fixed a payload-substitution bug (RFC 7797 'b64' honoured from an unauthenticated header) and a fail-open on zero-length HMAC secrets during verification. Hardened base64url to strict canonical decoding, restricted 'zip' to the protected header, enforced JWK use/key_ops/alg, and rejected mixed JWS JSON forms. Two RFC 7797 fixtures corrected to the RFC 7797 4.2 values. Follow-up 2026-08-05: EncryptJSON now honours caller-supplied algorithm inputs (an explicit PBES2 p2s/p2c or AESGCMKW iv was rejected as a repeated parameter, and ECDH-ES apu/apv never reached the Concat KDF, producing undecryptable documents); added the producer-side counterparts of the consumer's crit, repeated-parameter, per-recipient-zip and PBES2 salt-bound checks. Release 0.2.0 (2026-08-11): fixed the five published advisories against <= 0.1.0 — GHSA-4689 ('crit' satisfiable from an unprotected header; 'crit' and the parameters it names are now read from the protected header only), GHSA-657x (unprotected {"b64":false} payload substitution), and GHSA-w4qr / GHSA-qvw9 / GHSA-89qh (JWK alg/use/key_ops now enforced, with dedicated sentinel errors). Parity 144/157 (91.7%) -> 151/157 (96.2%).
